steps.title: grasp vlabench entity
steps.code:
sd_handle = res_loc_sd.output["evidence_handle"]
dishes_handle = res_loc_dishes.output["evidence_handle"]
pan_handle = res_loc_pan.output["evidence_handle"]
print("sd:", sd_handle, res_loc_sd.output["world_target"])
print("dishes:", dishes_handle, res_loc_dishes.output["world_target"])
print("pan:", pan_handle, res_loc_pan.output["world_target"])

res_grasp = primitives.call(
    name="grasp_vlabench_entity",
    entity_name="salad_dressing",
    evidence_handles=[sd_handle],
    prompt="grasp salad_dressing",
)
print(
    "grasp ok:",
    res_grasp.ok,
    "keys:",
    list(res_grasp.output.keys()) if res_grasp.ok else res_grasp.output,
)
if res_grasp.ok:
    for k in [
        "event",
        "ok",
        "selected_entity",
        "grasped_obj_name",
        "observation_serial",
    ]:
        if k in res_grasp.output:
            print(k, ":", res_grasp.output[k])
    if "object_grounding_evidence" in res_grasp.output:
        print(
            "grasped:",
            res_grasp.output["object_grounding_evidence"].get(
                "grasped_obj_name"
            ),
        )

steps.code:
res_loc_sd4 = primitives.call(
    name="locate_vlabench_entity",
    entity_name="salad_dressing",
    prompt="locate salad_dressing from close hover",
)
sd4_handle = res_loc_sd4.output["evidence_handle"]
pts4 = res_loc_sd4.output["entity"]["point_cloud_evidence"][
    "points_world_sample"
]
# Filter out counter outliers (e.g. x > 0.1 or y > -0.05)
valid_pts = [p for p in pts4 if -0.15 < p[0] < 0.08 and -0.28 < p[1] < -0.10]
print("valid_pts:", valid_pts)
if valid_pts:
    mx = sum(p[0] for p in valid_pts) / len(valid_pts)
    my = sum(p[1] for p in valid_pts) / len(valid_pts)
    mz = sum(p[2] for p in valid_pts) / len(valid_pts)
    print("mean valid pt:", [mx, my, mz])

# Let's hover directly over [-0.04, -0.21, 0.83] with yaw aligned perpendicular to the bottle
res_hover2 = primitives.call(
    name="move_vlabench_ee_to",
    evidence_handles=[sd4_handle],
    target_name="salad_dressing",
    target_position=[-0.04, -0.21, 0.82],
    target_euler=[3.14159, 0.0, 0.75],
    gripper_state=0.04,
    horizon=20,
    prompt="align gripper over bottle",
)
print("hover2 end_ee:", res_hover2.output["end_ee_position"])

steps.code:
res_loc_sd5 = primitives.call(
    name="locate_vlabench_entity",
    entity_name="salad_dressing",
    prompt="locate salad_dressing",
)
sd5_handle = res_loc_sd5.output["evidence_handle"]

# Hover over the middle of the lying bottle: x=-0.04, y=-0.185, z=0.81, yaw=0.35
res_hover3 = primitives.call(
    name="move_vlabench_ee_to",
    evidence_handles=[sd5_handle],
    target_name="salad_dressing",
    target_position=[-0.04, -0.185, 0.81],
    target_euler=[3.14159, 0.0, 0.35],
    gripper_state=0.04,
    horizon=20,
    prompt="hover directly over bottle neck",
)
print("hover3 end_ee:", res_hover3.output["end_ee_position"])

# Lower down to z=0.735 to straddle the bottle
res_down = primitives.call(
    name="move_vlabench_ee_to",
    evidence_handles=[sd5_handle],
    target_name="salad_dressing",
    target_position=[-0.04, -0.185, 0.735],
    target_euler=[3.14159, 0.0, 0.35],
    gripper_state=0.04,
    horizon=25,
    prompt="lower onto bottle",
)
print("down end_ee:", res_down.output["end_ee_position"])

# Close gripper
res_close = primitives.call(
    name="close_vlabench_gripper", horizon=15, prompt="close gripper on bottle"
)
print("close ok:", res_close.ok)

# Lift slightly to check grasp
res_lift_check = primitives.call(
    name="move_vlabench_ee_to",
    evidence_handles=[sd5_handle],
    target_name="salad_dressing",
    target_position=[-0.04, -0.185, 0.85],
    target_euler=[3.14159, 0.0, 0.35],
    gripper_state=0.0,
    horizon=20,
    prompt="lift bottle",
)
print("lift_check end_ee:", res_lift_check.output["end_ee_position"])

res_obs3 = primitives.call(
    name="observe_vlabench_scene", prompt="check grasp after lift"
)
oge3 = res_obs3.output["object_grounding_evidence"]
print("grasped:", oge3.get("grasped_obj_name"))
print("sd xpos:", oge3["entity_evidence"]["salad_dressing"]["xpos"])

# Lift higher first while keeping gripper closed so the bottle doesn't hit the pan rim
res_lift_high = primitives.call(
    name="move_vlabench_ee_to",
    evidence_handles=[dishes2_handle],
    target_name="dishes",
    target_position=[-0.04, -0.18, 0.92],
    target_euler=[3.14159, 0.0, 0.35],
    gripper_state=0.0,
    horizon=20,
    prompt="lift bottle high",
)
print("lift_high end_ee:", res_lift_high.output["end_ee_position"])

# Move above dishes place point [-0.202, -0.116, 0.90]
res_over_dishes = primitives.call(
    name="move_vlabench_ee_to",
    evidence_handles=[dishes2_handle],
    target_name="dishes",
    target_position=[-0.202, -0.116, 0.90],
    target_euler=[3.14159, 0.0, 0.35],
    gripper_state=0.0,
    horizon=25,
    prompt="move bottle over dishes",
)
print("over_dishes end_ee:", res_over_dishes.output["end_ee_position"])

res_obs4 = primitives.call(
    name="observe_vlabench_scene", prompt="check bottle over dishes"
)
oge4 = res_obs4.output["object_grounding_evidence"]
print("grasped:", oge4.get("grasped_obj_name"))

    "sd xpos:",
    oge4["entity_evidence"]["salad_dressing"]["xpos"],

    oge4["entity_evidence"]["salad_dressing"]["xquat"],
)
print("dishes xpos:", oge4["entity_evidence"]["dishes"]["xpos"])

# Locate dishes in current frame and test place_vlabench_entity_in or pouring/placing over dishes
res_loc_dishes3 = primitives.call(
    name="locate_vlabench_entity", entity_name="dishes", prompt="locate dishes"
)
dishes3_handle = res_loc_dishes3.output["evidence_handle"]
print("dishes3_handle:", dishes3_handle)

# Let's try place_vlabench_entity_in on dishes first to see what SkillLib controller does!
res_place = primitives.call(
    name="place_vlabench_entity_in",
    container_name="dishes",
    evidence_handles=[dishes3_handle],
    use_native_place_point=True,
    prompt="place salad_dressing in dishes",
)
print("place ok:", res_place.ok)
if res_place.ok:
    for k in [
        "event",
        "stage_ok",
        "stepped",
        "target_position",
        "target_quat",
        "waypoint_count",
        "last_waypoint",
    ]:
        if k in res_place.output:
            print(k, ":", res_place.output[k])

res_obs5 = primitives.call(
    name="observe_vlabench_scene", prompt="observe after place_entity_in"
)
oge5 = res_obs5.output["object_grounding_evidence"]
print("grasped after place:", oge5.get("grasped_obj_name"))

    "sd xpos:",
    oge5["entity_evidence"]["salad_dressing"]["xpos"],

)
print("dishes xpos:", oge5["entity_evidence"]["dishes"]["xpos"])
